intent.proves: No product group is attached to more than one shop or channel (ShopType 1 or 3).
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global; at least one subject must be in scope

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(r.ShopGroupGroupId AS nvarchar(50)) FROM EcomShopGroupRelation r JOIN EcomShops s ON s.ShopId = r.ShopGroupShopId AND s.ShopType IN (1, 3) GROUP BY r.ShopGroupGroupId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.ShopGroupShopId) > 1
bindings.subjectsQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.ShopGroupGroupId) FROM EcomShopGroupRelation r JOIN EcomShops s ON s.ShopId = r.ShopGroupShopId AND s.ShopType IN (1, 3)
